args.title: Add TSV export format for reports
args.body: File: src/exportUtils.ts. Add "tsv" to SUPPORTED_FORMATS and a corresponding entry in CONTENT_TYPES (e.g. "text/tab-separated-values; charset=utf-8"), and extend toDelimited (or add a tab-delimited variant) so report exports can be written with a tab separator instead of a comma, mirroring the existing CSV writer in src/export/csv.ts. This lets src/api/reports.ts accept format=tsv alongside csv and xlsx, so warehouse loads no longer break on commas in free-text fields like transaction descriptions.
